definitions: To suggest or present something for consideration.
To increase a price or amount.
To preserve food, especially fruit or vegetables, in jars or cans.
examples: They put up a new fence around the garden.
Can you put me up for the night?
She put up a good argument.
I don't know how she puts up with him.
The landlord put up the rent again.
My grandmother used to put up her own jam.
pastTenses: put up (past simple), put up (present perfect)
